pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: KV prefix hit-rate drop for VelaBank (VPC tenant). Severity: P1. Alerts: kv-prefetch-errors > 300/min, prefetched_prefix_evictions spike.

ida: I'm on it. Seeing a sharp drop in prefix hit-rate for tenant vela-bank-prod across two dedicated pools. KV cache miss rate jumped from 3% -> 47% in 3m.

sanjay: copying stats from the dashboard: `pool-a1`: miss 52%, `pool-a2`: miss 45%. Latency 95p for generate calls increased ~120ms. Customers are seeing timeouts on batch endpoints.

marta: @ida any recent config changes? Rolling deploy?

ida: No deploys in the last hour. But there's a spike in prefix prefetch volume from vela-bank's service — looks like a runaway prefetcher with overbroad prefixes (wildcard "vela/*") which is pulling unrelated tenant prefixes into the same shard-level cache. Suspect cache pollution.

kevin: paste logs (truncated):
```
2026-03-15T10:48:12Z prefetched prefix "vela/*" -> keys 120000
2026-03-15T10:48:18Z eviction: shard-23 TTL pressure -> evict candidate count 10342
2026-03-15T10:49:01Z client=vela-bank service=tokenizer prefetched_prefix=vela/* status=ok
2026-03-15T10:49:07Z kv-lookup tenant=other-tenant prefixed_match=true -> cold-miss
```

leo: If prefetch keys are that large, they can thrash the shard's working set and push out other tenants' prefixes. That explains the cross-tenant hit-rate collapse we saw.

ida: Immediate mitigations I propose: 1) Disable prefix prefetch for vela-bank (temporary), 2) Evict the large prefetched prefixes belonging to vela-bank from affected shards, 3) Route vela-bank traffic to a fallback dedicated pool with isolated cache while we stabilize.

marta: Agreed. @sanjay can you run the cache-disable command?

sanjay: Running now. Command: 
```
curl -X POST "https://control.redwood.internal/api/v1/tenants/vela-bank/cache/disable" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"feature":"prefix_prefetch","reason":"incident:cache-pollution"}'
```

(oncall-bot): command accepted. Feature `prefix_prefetch` disabled for tenant vela-bank.

kevin: Disabling prefetch reduced prefetch traffic immediately. Observability: prefix_preload_rate for vela-bank dropped from 18k/s -> 200/s.

ida: Kicked off eviction job against shards [23,41,7]. Using eviction-safe window: don't evict active keys older than 30s to avoid tail latency.

leo: Evictions completed for shard-23 and shard-41. Shard-7 eviction in progress. Hit-rate trending up on shard-23 already (32% -> 67%).

vela-sre: Thanks for the fast response. We're seeing transient API 5xxs during the mitigation window — do you have an ETA to fully restore?

ida: ETA ~ 12-18 minutes for full catch-up after shard-7 finishes. We'll keep VelaBank on the fallback pool to protect other tenants. We'll also throttle their prefetcher if they try to re-enable.

marta: Routing change executed: vela-bank->pool-fallback-b (isolated). Connection drain started.

(ops-note): Added temporary circuit-breaker rule to reject prefetch requests > 5k keys/min from a single client.

kevin: Post-mitigation numbers: global prefix hit-rate back to 92% for affected shards, overall system latencies back to baseline. No further 5xxs observed in last 3 mins.

ida: Handoff to oncall-next: @kevin you'll take post-incident monitoring and follow-ups. Key follow-ups: 1) Permanent guardrails (prefetch rate limiter by tenant), 2) Prefetch quota enforcement + alert if wildcard pattern expands beyond 1k keys, 3) Investigate why vela-bank's prefetcher used a wildcard and recommend SDK change, 4) Add tighter shard-level isolation for enterprise VPC tenants.

kevin: Taking handoff. I'll keep a 30m watch and coordinate postmortem.

marta: Customer update posted to customer-comms (private) — thanks @ida @sanjay.

ida: Quick notes for postmortem: cause = runaway prefetch from vela-bank using broad prefix rule causing cache pollution and cross-tenant eviction; detection = kv-prefetch-errors + hit-rate alert; mitigations = disable prefetch + targeted evictions + fallback pool + prefetch throttle; impact = increased latencies and some 5xxs for other tenants for ~12 minutes; severity=P1.

vela-sre: Appreciate the transparency. We'll patch our prefetcher and coordinate the SDK change. Expect a PR today to stop wildcard prefeteches.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged closed by ida. Follow-ups assigned to kevin (owner).

ida: I'll draft the incident timeline and postmortem draft after handoff.

kevin: Logged action items in ops board: OP-6523 (prefetch rate limiter), OP-6524 (tenant-prefetch quotas), OP-6525 (dashboard/alert tune).

marta: Nice work. :thumbsup:

ida: closing slack thread for now, monitoring continues.
